data_fields.name: target_interval
data_fields.donor_constant: 1000 / fps, truncated to whole ms by uint storage

best_idea: Pace a client frame by the time since the last present, not by the loop body, and turn the remaining wait into a draw-skip gate; keep the target as a float so the cap is exact.
decision_why: A browser cannot sleep, so the wait becomes a skip gate for an optional low-end phone cap; the float target fixes the donor's 60 fps to 62.5 fps truncation; the fight step stays on the server tick and never uses measured frame time (GPL, clean-room only).
acceptance: With the phone cap at 60 fps the presented interval averages 16.67 ms over 10 s (not 16 ms, which is 62.5 fps); with the cap at 30 fps the presented count is 30 +/- 1 per second, and the fight tick count is identical at 30 fps and at 60 fps.
